ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var rlId = if (isEmpty(payload.Rocketlane_Id__c)) vars.txnRecords[0].External_Id__c else payload.Rocketlane_Id__c --- (payload - "Rocketlane_Id__c") ++ { Rocketlane_Id__c: rlId }

%dw 2.0 output application/java fun cut(t, n) = if (sizeOf(t) > n) t[0 to n - 1] else t --- [{ Id: vars.txnId, Request_Status__c: "Created", External_Id__c: ((vars.rlResponse.projectId default vars.rlProjectId) default "") as String, Request_Payload__c: cut(write(vars.rlRequest default {}, "application/json"), 32000), Response_Payload__c: cut(write(vars.rlResponse default {}, "application/json"), 32000), Last_Attempt_At__c: now(), Last_Synced_At__c: now(), Mule_Correlation_Id__c: correlationId, fieldsToNull: ["Last_Error__c", "Last_Error_Short__c", "Error_Category__c", "Next_Retry_At__c"] }]

%dw 2.0 output application/java fun cut(t, n) = if (sizeOf(t) > n) t[0 to n - 1] else t var code = (error.childErrors[0].errorMessage.attributes.statusCode default error.errorMessage.attributes.statusCode) default null var category = if (code == null or code == 429 or code >= 500) "Transient" else if (code == 401 or code == 403) "Auth" else "Mapping" var response = (error.childErrors[0].errorMessage.payload default error.errorMessage.payload) default "" var message = (error.description default "") ++ " | HTTP status: " ++ ((code default "none") as String) ++ " | Rocketlane response: " ++ write(response, "application/json") --- [{ Id: vars.txnId, Request_Status__c: if (category == "Transient") "Retrying" else "Failed - Terminal", Error_Category__c: category, Last_Error__c: cut(message, 32000), Last_Error_Short__c: cut(message, 255), Request_Payload__c: cut(write(vars.rlRequest default {}, "application/json"), 32000), Last_Attempt_At__c: now(), Mule_Correlation_Id__c: correlationId, (Next_Retry_At__c: now() + |PT15M|) if (category == "Transient") }]

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Rocketlane request FAILED for transaction " ++ (vars.txnId default "?") ++ ", Project " ++ (vars.requestProjectId default "?") ++ ": " ++ (payload[0].Last_Error_Short__c default "")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java // Rocketlane field (config key) -> Salesforce Account field and type var fieldMap = [ { key: "websiteBuildStatus", sf: "Website_Build_Status__c", t: "text" }, { key: "websiteLaunchDate", sf: "Website_Launch_Date__c", t: "date" }, { key: "websiteAbandonedDate", sf: "Website_Abandoned_Date__c", t: "date" }, { key: "ncrmImplementationStatus", sf: "NCRM_Implementation_Status__c", t: "text" }, { key: "ncrmImplementationCompleteDate", sf: "NCRM_Implementation_Complete_Date__c", t: "date" }, { key: "ncrmImplementationIncompleteDate", sf: "NCRM_Implementation_Incomplete_Date__c", t: "date" }, { key: "artsPeopleImplementationStatus", sf: "Arts_People_Implementation_Status__c", t: "text" }, { key: "artsPeopleImplementationCompleteDate", sf: "Arts_People_Implementation_Complete_Date__c", t: "date" }, { key: "artsPeopleImplementationIncompleteDate", sf: "Arts_People_Implementation_Incomplete_Da__c", t: "date" }, { key: "rallyboundImplementationIncompleteDate", sf: "Rallybound_Implementation_Incomplete_Dat__c", t: "date" }, { key: "onboardingCompleteNotes", sf: "Implementation_Complete_Notes__c", t: "text" }, { key: "websiteDesigner", sf: "Website_Designer__c", t: "user" } ] map ((m) -> m ++ { id: p("secure::rocketlaneFields." ++ m.key) }) var changed = (payload.changeLog.to.fields default []) filter ((f) -> fieldMap.id contains (f.fieldId as String)) fun blank(v) = v == null or (v is String and trim(v) == "") var rows = changed map ((f) -> do { var m = (fieldMap filter ((x) -> x.id == (f.fieldId as String)))[0] --- { sf: m.sf, t: m.t, value: f.fieldValue, email: if (m.t == "user") (f.fieldValue.emailId default null) else null } }) var accountId = ((payload.data.project.fields default []) filter ((f) -> (f.fieldId as String) == p("secure::rocketlaneFields.sfId")))[0].fieldValue --- { accountId: accountId, projectId: payload.data.project.projectId, actor: payload.source.actor.emailId default "", rows: rows }
